subject: Re: Post-call: ACME AI - Private/VPC security discovery & SOC 2 next steps
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acmeai.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmeai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Apr 2028 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call recap: Private/VPC security discovery & next steps

Thanks for your time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned.

Key takeaways from the call:
- ACME is evaluating Redwood for a customer-facing assistant that will process PII (customer names, emails, and support transcripts).
- Primary requirement: private deployment pattern (VPC / dedicated) with network isolation and strong audit logging.
- Compliance needs: SOC 2 in-scope asap; GDPR applies (EU customers); potential HIPAA applicability for a subset of customers.
- ACME interested in an on-prem or air-gapped option for regulated workloads long-term, but initial pilot can run in a customer-dedicated VPC.

Open / action items:
1) We will send a short SOC 2 status summary and our standard deployment diagram for VPC/dedicated setups. (Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, redwood-deployment-diagram.png)
2) We’ll initiate the vendor security questionnaire (SSQ) and share an editable copy; requesting ACME’s security contact to complete items that require customer input. (Attachment: vendor-ssq-initiation.xlsx)
3) ACME to confirm whether HIPAA is mandatory for the pilot or only for later phases. If HIPAA applies now we’ll route to our compliance team for BAA discussion.
4) Proposed next call: technical deep-dive with ACME infra + our Private deployment engineering (30–45 min). Suggested week of Apr 25.

Notes on the deployment options we discussed:
- Dedicated VPC (hosted private): Redwood control plane in our region, customer-managed VPC peering or PrivateLink, with encryption-in-transit + optional customer-managed KMS for keys.
- Private/on-prem: customer controls the entire deployment; typical pattern includes air-gapped packaging of runtime, local KMS/HSM integrations, and out-of-band telemetry collection if allowed.
- Audit and logging: we provide per-request audit logs, token-level tracing, and configurable retention (defaults with enterprise plans).

Next steps on our side: Marissa will send the SSQ + Drive folder with deployment artifacts; Rachel will coordinate the technical deep-dive scheduling. I’ll follow up with a SOC 2 checklist and timeline.

Thanks again — we’ll be responsive to any questions as you review.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Principal Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

---
Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (summary), redwood-deployment-diagram.png (png), vendor-ssq-initiation.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmeai.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acmeai.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Apr 2028 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Private/VPC security discovery & next steps

Thanks Marcus — helpful recap. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

1) For the pilot, we want the data to remain in our VPC in us-west-2 and prefer PrivateLink over VPC peering if supported. Is PrivateLink supported for the dedicated option?
2) SOC 2 status: can you confirm whether your SOC 2 Type II covers the hosted API and dedicated deployments, or only the hosted control plane? We need to map scope for our procurement team.
3) HIPAA: currently only a potential future requirement — not required for the pilot.

We’re available for the technical deep-dive Apr 26 or 27 after 13:00 PT.

-Appreciate it,
Priya Shah
Head of Security & Privacy | ACME AI
priya.shah@acmeai.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Apr 2028 16:00:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Post-call recap: ACME AI - actions (SSQ + diagrams + deep-dive)

Marissa / Rachel — forwarding ACME thread. Please action the items below: 

Marissa:
- Attach the SSQ initiation spreadsheet (vendor-ssq-initiation.xlsx) and create a Drive folder with initial artifacts (SOC2 summary + deployment diagram). Use the Drive link pattern we discussed and share edit rights with priya.shah@acmeai.com and daniel.park@acmeai.com.
- Include a short cover note that explains where we have gaps (e.g., private on-prem packaging lead times, required customer infra pieces).

Rachel:
- Coordinate the technical deep-dive: propose Apr 26 14:00 PT or Apr 27 14:00 PT and include engineering leads from our Private deployment team.
- Prepare a one-page checklist for what the ACME infra team needs (VPC CIDR info, PrivateLink setup, KMS details, outbound firewall rules if using peering).

Also: can you both confirm whether the attached redwood-soc2-summary.pdf clearly states which components are in-scope (control plane, hosted API, dedicated runtime)? If not, update quickly and re-upload. Procurement will need that mapping.

I’ll loop back with an internal note on BAA only if Priya confirms HIPAA is required.

Thanks — Marcus

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acmeai.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmeai.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Apr 2028 09:18:00 +0000
Subject: Vendor SSQ + Drive: Redwood artifacts for ACME pilot

Hi Priya / Daniel — thanks again for the time on Friday. I’ve created a Drive folder with the artifacts we discussed and attached the initial SSQ workbook for your security team to review. Link and quick instructions below.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AExampleLinkRedwood-ACME
Files included:
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf — brief status & what’s in-scope (control plane + dedicated runtime are included in our current Type II scope; see section 2).
- redwood-deployment-diagram.png — recommended VPC/dedicated topology and network flows (public control plane + private runtime with PrivateLink option annotated).
- vendor-ssq-initiation.xlsx — editable SSQ workbook; we filled vendor answers for items we can complete and left the "ACME action" column for items requiring your input.

Quick notes on your questions: 
- PrivateLink: yes, we support PrivateLink for dedicated VPCs in us-west-2; we annotated the diagram with the flow.
- SOC 2 scope: control plane and dedicated runtime are in-scope for our current Type II report; hosted multi-tenant API components are covered separately — see the SOC2 summary doc for full mapping. We can provide the Type II report under an NDA / secure transfer.
- HIPAA: since this is not required for the pilot, we’ll track it as a downstream compliance workstream. If you later confirm HIPAA, we’ll start BAA conversations and provide the additional implementation checklist.

Next steps for your team:
1) Please start the SSQ and fill ACME-specific items (network endpoints, expected throughput, retention retention policy choices).
2) Confirm preferred deep-dive slot (Apr 26 14:00 PT or Apr 27 14:00 PT).
3) If you want the SOC 2 Type II report ahead of procurement, send an NDA and we’ll share via secure link.

Attachments: vendor-ssq-initiation.xlsx

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success | Redwood Inference
